title: Decreta Alexii patriarchae (additamentum)
review_scope: Visual comparison of the Greek reading text on all 15 printed pages 28-42, including the subscription. German commentary and footnotes are excluded. This is a single review, not an independently measured character-error rate.

corrections.evidence: Printed page 29, first word; enlarged scan resolves tau, not iota.

page_joins.evidence: Printed pages 28-29 split one word at the page boundary.
Printed pages 37-38 split περιέρχεσθαι; the OCR adds a breathing to the second part.

folio_policy: Printed slashes indicate the manuscript folio boundaries named in the margin. Remove them from reading words and retain their source-page offsets and folio names in the audit.
identity_policy: The Greek Library edition ID is retained as a provider identifier. It is not promoted to a canonical TLG work anchor without independent authority evidence.
